envelope.revision_rule: An integer committed project revision when a project snapshot is observed; null when no service revision was observed, including a transport-decoded validation rejection before project lookup.
envelope.as_of: Authoritative service/store clock in RFC3339 UTC.
envelope.next_status_change_at: RFC3339 UTC timestamp or null; derived from the same snapshot clock.

identity_rules.clock_owner: local Rust service or the same application in offline maintenance mode
identity_rules.legacy_lease_alias: --ttl is accepted only as an alias for --lease-ttl
identity_rules.hard_budget_rule: Heartbeats and lease renewal never extend max_attempt_deadline.
identity_rules.dependency_satisfaction: Only accepted closed results satisfy a default prerequisite edge.
identity_rules.review_rule: Independent review is required only when the versioned acceptance profile contains a review gate.

bounds.unknown_fields: ignored after validation and never interpreted as policy
